changes: Keep BinaryTrie byte-identical: some compressed public API cases are slower.
Add separately guarded CompressedBinaryTrie with independently implemented path compression and index-based storage.
Preserve duplicate counts, anonymous/explicit IDs, lazy XOR, order statistics and logical uncompressed NODES capacity.
Add insert_unique and reserve; fast buffered judge driver skips runtime checks.

measurement.runtime_checks: SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS defined for both local baseline and compressed submission
measurement.order: alternating old/new, median of seven whole-process wall timings
limitations: Local machine differs from online judge; no claim of 21 ms.
End-to-end speedup includes buffered IO, single-pass insertion and reserve, not just compression.
Broad candidate benchmark wait4 RSS inherits the parent maximum; final /usr/bin/time RSS replaces this for the insertion-heavy claim.
API microbenchmarks use repeating query vectors; absolute times depend on workload.

public_api_measurement.order: old/new alternating, seven timings each, median
public_api_measurement.query_mix: half sampled from inserted values, half random full-range; min/max repeated unchanged trie behind compiler memory barrier

limitations: Local tests only; no online AC claim.
SIZE_MAX element-count overflow cannot be constructed in a finite practical test.

normalization_proof.normalization: remove line comments and whitespace; replace CompressedBinaryTrie identifier and dedicated include guard with old candidate names

license.new_implementation: Implemented from data-structure invariants and the existing CC0 API; no fastest-submission code was copied.
license.reference_role: Existing BinaryTrie API ancestry, not a copied Patricia implementation.
license.checker_tools: Official checker and testlib are validation tools in /tmp, not included in the CC0 library.

limits: CompressedBinaryTrie is optional; no global non-regression claim.
Dense 16-bit count/find were about 2x and count_less about 2.8-2.9x slower than classic BinaryTrie in the recorded measurements.
Skewed branching and other API mixes can favor the classic class.
Vector growth can cost O(number of nodes) for an individual insertion; O(B) insertion is amortized.
reserve reserves distinct-value capacity, not total duplicate count.
SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS requires valid input and retains internal capacity/overflow protections.

online_after.source_match: Equal after CRLF normalization, blank-line removal and exclusion of // Submission: metadata lines only.

online_comparison.note: The prior official API reports 350 ms; the user initially reported 349 ms. Local comparisons define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS for both, whereas the uploaded older source did not.
